# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m knowledge_engine.core.settings --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every environment variable the engine reads, with its type and default.
Print the effective values (secrets masked) with `knowledge-engine config show`.

Booleans accept `1`/`true`/`yes`/`on` and `0`/`false`/`no`/`off` (case-insensitive;
an empty value is off). An unparseable value is logged as a WARNING and the default
is used instead.

## Paths

| Variable | Type | Default | Description | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KE_HOME` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Engine home. Unset: the nearest directory at or above the working directory that contains corpus/registry.json, else the working directory. | `core.paths` |
| `KE_CORPUS_ROOT` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Corpus root. Unset: <home>/corpus. | `core.paths` |
| `KE_REGISTRY_PATH` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Registry JSON (the source of truth). Unset: <corpus_root>/registry.json. | `core.paths` |
| `KE_DATA_DIR` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Runtime data directory (FTS index, board DB, embeddings). Unset: <home>/.knowledge-engine/data. | `core.paths` |

## HTTP server

| Variable | Type | Default | Description | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KE_PORT` | int | *(unset)* | Default port of `knowledge-engine serve` when --port is not given (unset: 9210); also the board client's port fallback. | `cli, agent_board.cli` |
| `KE_BIND_HOST` | string | `127.0.0.1` | Address the HTTP app is bound to; selects the /mcp Host-header policy. `knowledge-engine serve --host` sets it. | `server.app` |
| `KE_CORS_ORIGINS` | string | *(empty)* | Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the engine API. Empty: loopback origins only. `*` allows any origin. | `server.app` |
| `KE_LOG_LEVEL` | string | `INFO` | Level of the knowledge_engine logger hierarchy for `serve`, `board-serve` and `mcp`. | `core.logging_config, mcp.server` |
| `KE_MCP_HTTP` | bool | `0` | Mount the MCP streamable-HTTP endpoint at /mcp on the engine app. | `server.app` |
| `KE_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | string | *(empty)* | Extra Host-header names accepted by /mcp (comma-separated; `*` disables the check). | `mcp.http` |
| `KE_TRUST_PROXY` | bool | `0` | Honour X-Forwarded-For from KE_TRUSTED_PROXIES (board trust gate and uvicorn). | `core.http, agent_board.http` |
| `KE_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to speak for clients via X-Forwarded-For. Unset: loopback. Empty: none. | `core.http, agent_board.http` |

## Agent board

| Variable | Type | Default | Description | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KE_BOARD_ENABLED` | bool | `1` | Mount the agent board at /board on the engine app. | `server.app` |
| `KE_BOARD_SWEEPER` | bool (optional) | *(unset)* | Boot override for the board sweeper thread. Unset: the persisted board_config.sweeper_enabled flag decides (default on). | `agent_board.sweeper, server.lifespan, agent_board.service` |
| `KE_BOARD_TRUSTED_CIDRS` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Comma-separated CIDRs of trusted board peers. Unset: loopback + Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10. Empty: loopback only. | `agent_board.http` |
| `KE_BOARD_CORS_ORIGINS` | string | *(empty)* | CORS allow-list of the standalone board service (same syntax as KE_CORS_ORIGINS). | `agent_board.service` |
| `KE_BOARD_MAX_SCOPES` | int | `64` | Cap on per-scope board databases (0 = unlimited; negative values count as 0). | `agent_board.scopes` |
| `BOARD_HOST` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Default bind address of `knowledge-engine board-serve` when --host is not given (unset: 127.0.0.1). | `cli` |
| `BOARD_PORT` | int | *(unset)* | Default port of `knowledge-engine board-serve` when --port is not given; wins over KE_BOARD_STANDALONE_PORT. | `cli` |
| `KE_BOARD_STANDALONE_PORT` | int | `11437` | Port of the standalone board service when neither --port nor BOARD_PORT is given. | `agent_board.service, cli` |
| `KE_BOARD_URL` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Base URL the `knowledge-engine board` client talks to. | `agent_board.cli` |
| `KE_BOARD_PORT` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Port the board client uses when KE_BOARD_URL is unset (falls back to KE_PORT, then 9210). | `agent_board.cli` |
| `KE_BOARD_KEY` | secret | *(unset)* | X-Board-Key the board client presents when --key is not given. Secret: masked by `config show`. | `agent_board.cli` |

## Generation providers

| Variable | Type | Default | Description | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KE_PROVIDER_ORDER` | string | *(empty)* | Comma-separated provider names tried first, in this order (e.g. `ollama,cloud-http`); unlisted providers follow in the default order (cloud-http, ollama, echo). | `generation.factory` |
| `KE_PROVIDER_PROBE_TTL` | float | `30` | Seconds a provider availability probe is cached (0 = probe on every request). | `generation.base` |
| `KE_PROVIDER_STARTUP_PROBE` | bool | `1` | Probe every provider in the background at startup and warn about unreachable ones. | `server.lifespan` |
| `KE_CLOUD_ENDPOINT` | string | *(empty)* | Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. https://api.example/v1); the provider POSTs to <endpoint>/chat/completions. | `generation.cloud_http` |
| `KE_CLOUD_API_KEY` | secret | *(unset)* | Bearer token for KE_CLOUD_ENDPOINT. The cloud-http provider is registered only when both are set. Secret: masked by `config show`. | `generation.cloud_http, agent_board.provider_registry` |
| `KE_CLOUD_MODEL` | string | *(empty)* | Default model for cloud-http when a request names none. | `generation.cloud_http` |
| `KE_CLOUD_TIMEOUT` | float | `60` | Timeout in seconds for one cloud-http completion request. | `generation.cloud_http` |
| `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Ollama server for the ollama generation provider. | `generation.ollama_provider` |
| `OLLAMA_MODEL` | string | `llama3.2` | Default Ollama model when a request names none. | `generation.ollama_provider` |
| `OLLAMA_TIMEOUT` | float | `30` | Timeout in seconds for one Ollama generate request. | `generation.ollama_provider` |
| `KE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | secret | *(unset)* | Default env binding for the `anthropic` board provider credential. Secret: masked by `config show`. | `agent_board.provider_registry` |
| `KE_OPENAI_API_KEY` | secret | *(unset)* | Default env binding for the `openai` board provider credential. Secret: masked by `config show`. | `agent_board.provider_registry` |

## Embeddings (semantic and hybrid search)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KE_EMBED_PROVIDER` | string | `ollama` | Embedding provider of the corpus embedding index: `ollama` (local Ollama at KE_OLLAMA_URL), `remote` (KE_EMBED_REMOTE_URL; needs KE_EMBED_ALLOW_REMOTE=1) or `fake` (offline, deterministic; tests and dry runs). | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |
| `KE_EMBED_MODEL` | string | `bge-m3:latest` | Embedding model (bge-m3 by default). The index records it and refuses vectors of another model; rebuild with `knowledge-engine embeddings build --rebuild` after changing it. | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |
| `KE_EMBED_BATCH` | int | `32` | Texts sent per embedding request while building the index. | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |
| `KE_OLLAMA_URL` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Ollama server of the `ollama` embedding provider. | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |
| `KE_EMBED_REMOTE_URL` | string | *(empty)* | Endpoint of the `remote` embedding provider (POST {model, input} per text; answers {embedding} or {embeddings}). | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |
| `KE_EMBED_ALLOW_REMOTE` | bool | `0` | Opt-in gate of the `remote` embedding provider: corpus text is sent off-machine only when this is on. | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |
| `KE_EMBEDDINGS_DB` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Corpus embedding index (SQLite). Unset: <data_dir>/embeddings.db. | `retrieval.embeddings.factory` |

## Pipeline and substrates

| Variable | Type | Default | Description | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KE_PIPELINE_DB` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Board/pipeline SQLite database. Unset: <data_dir>/pipeline.db. | `runtime.foundation.db` |
| `KE_PIPELINE_ROOT` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Pipeline root (YAML config, and the .env the CLI/MCP server/app load at startup). Unset: ./pipeline. | `runtime.foundation.config` |
| `KE_CONFIG_DIR` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | Pipeline YAML config directory. Unset: <KE_PIPELINE_ROOT>/config. | `runtime.foundation.config` |
| `KE_CONFIG_PATH` | string (optional) | *(unset)* | project-context TOML config file. | `project_context.config` |
| `KE_CLASSIFIER_MODEL` | string | `qwen3:4b` | Model of the pipeline task classifier. | `runtime.pipeline.task_classifier` |
| `KE_CLASSIFIER_ENDPOINT` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate` | Endpoint of the pipeline task classifier. | `runtime.pipeline.task_classifier` |

Variables in the last section are read directly by the substrate modules named in
*Read by*; they are listed here so the whole surface is documented in one place.
